goal: Bring IMMUNE.md to the v4 Kernel path. It is the constitution agents read before selecting a route, and it still presents retired v3 machinery as live: line 44 describes imm-autowork as a deterministic checkpoint runtime, lines 72 and 74 build the L2S-WF mainline and multi-step advancement on imm-loop consuming imm-autowork checkpoints, and line 52 lists State Ledger among the artifacts a route may create. imm-autowork sits in RETIRED_MUTATING_COMMANDS and fails on invocation, and the v3 runtime island carrying State Ledger was deleted by 2026-08-19-008. The version line still reads v1.1.0 / 2026-05-29, predating the Kernel path entirely. This is the same defect class Phase 0 removed from dist/imm-loop.md, left in the one document with the widest reach. Rewrite the affected passages so the described mainline is Planner to Enrollment to imm-loop over TaskIntent and TaskRecord, and bump the version. Two premises of the original 2.2 roadmap draft no longer hold and are deliberately dropped rather than silently carried: the three BASELINE.md copies are already byte-identical at sha 140a3fad and their identity is enforced by tests/baseline-packaging-contract.test.ts, so collapsing them to a generated single source buys no invariant that is not already guaranteed; and AGENTS.md is 18 lines after Phase 0 removed the ctx_* tool block, so there is no roughly 80 percent overlapping IMMUNE-BRAIN block left to shrink. Scope is therefore the constitution alone. IMMUNE.md is not dist-synced, so no packaged copy follows. Three contract tests read it and must keep passing: pi-only-release-contract, direct-first-routing-contract, and managed-default-routing-contract.

acceptance.assertion: IMMUNE.md names no retired command or retired artifact as a live component, describes the mainline in terms of the Kernel path, and records a version bumped past v1.1.0 / 2026-05-29.
The three contract tests that read IMMUNE.md still pass: pi-only-release-contract, direct-first-routing-contract, and managed-default-routing-contract.
